notes.title: Holiday controller patch
notes.content:
Hello this is BATTLE X.

Holiday controller patch is finally here!

This patch addresses some inconvenience issue of using VR controllers.

Thanks to all the players who love BATTLE X and sent us feedback, we’ve taken one step closer to you.

Please check out on the updates in the Tutorial of the game before play.

Enjoy, and kindly let us know your thoughts.

Hope to see you guys more often in BATTLE X.

Happy holidays!
